label: The Musician
tagline: A reactive breath that earns its place by withholding itself
cluster_explainer: Practitioners read the engine for what it does to attention over time, with zero tolerance for popups or nudges.
demo_highlights: Bass-band reactance locks to pulse and breath so the engine feels like room temperature, not a screen
Smooth envelope with high smoothing keeps motion continuous — no jumps, no attention-grabbing transients
Sphere primitive has no edges to read, so the engine registers as presence rather than object
Smoke preset is the most withholding of the styles — the engine earns its place by withholding itself
Deep green palette carries no UI connotation, so the visual blends into the practice room instead of foregrounding itself
